cohort_checkpoint: explicit GO/STOP after G5 freeze; a clean cohort stop beats a leaky model

gates.G1_extraction_integrity: 100% of extracted tables: decompressed bytes pass zip CRC32 from central directory AND double-computed sha256 recorded; any mismatch -> re-extract once, else STOP
gates.G2_cohort: eligible cohort = INTERVENTIONAL studies in the 2024-06-01 snapshot with >=1 'Drug' intervention and overall_status in {COMPLETED,TERMINATED,WITHDRAWN,SUSPENDED}; all phases incl. N/A as own stratum. Sanity band 50k-250k NCTs; zero duplicate NCT IDs; per-status/per-phase counts recorded. Out-of-band -> STOP and report
gates.G3_mapping_coverage: condition->MeSH browse coverage >=85% of cohort trials; intervention-name->ChEMBL mapping (exact + normalized-name only, no fuzzy matching in R1) >=60% of distinct intervention names; trials without any mapping kept as 'unmapped' stratum (abstained from mechanism features, never dropped); ChEMBL release + UniProt release recorded
gates.G4_reason_audit: stratified audit sample n=240 (30 per each of 8 reason classes where cohort support allows; if a class supports <30 take all, note support). Coder A = taxonomy rules v1; Coder B = taxonomy rules v2 written independently (different anchor terms/structure). Cohen's kappa >=0.60 overall AND per-class agreement >=60% for any class used in training; failing classes merged to 'other' or abstained. Confusion matrix + abstention counts reported. RELIABILITY CHECKPOINT: do not train if unmet
gates.G5_freeze_before_validation: cohort IDs, mechanism-cluster IDs, competing-risk labels, missing-reason class, and snapshot base-rate baselines frozen with sha256 manifest; manifest timestamp must precede first 2026-06-01 validation fetch (both logged)
gates.G6_linkage_validation: 0 post-cutoff dates in cutoff features (row-level date audit); 0 duplicate NCTs across folds; >=100 typed validation events among cohort between 2024-06-01 and 2026-06-01 snapshots; retraction/publication linkage recorded as evidence flags only, never truth labels
gates.G7_model: run ONLY if G1-G6 pass: frozen logistic baseline + mechanistic ranking; ranking must beat both base-rate and logistic on PR-AUC, lift@50 >=1.5x base rate, ECE <=0.05 on temporal holdout; abstention coverage reported; label-noise sensitivity (labels perturbed within measured audit disagreement) reported. If any model criterion fails -> deliver bounded product (cohort+labels+events, no ranking claims)
